permissions.title: Desktop control
permissions.help: Allow Grok Desk to see the screen and control the mouse and keyboard when you turn it on for a task.
permissions.safety: Password managers and some system security apps are blocked when detected. Residual risk remains for password fields — review agent actions carefully.
permissions.enableConfirm: Desktop control lets Grok Desk move the mouse and type on this computer. Only enable for tasks you trust. You can pause anytime from the tray.
permissions.recentDecisionsDesc: Browse permission and tool decisions recorded on this machine.
permissions.recentDecisionsHint: Opens recent audit decisions across all tasks (first page; older rows may not all load).

filesystem.name: Filesystem
filesystem.description: Read and write files in your home directory and project folders.
filesystem.longDescription: The default local connector used by Claude Desktop and similar cowork apps. Grok can list, read, and edit files inside allowed roots without leaving Desk.

fetch.name: Web fetch
fetch.description: Pull public URLs for research, docs, and content drafts.
fetch.longDescription: Lightweight HTTP fetch for public pages — ideal for research briefs and competitor scans without a full browser automation stack.

memory-mcp.name: Knowledge graph memory
memory-mcp.description: Persist entities and relations across chats (beyond Desk memory).
memory-mcp.longDescription: MCP knowledge-graph memory used in Claude Desktop demos. Complements Grok Desk standing memory with a portable graph of people, projects, and facts.

sequential-thinking.name: Sequential thinking
sequential-thinking.description: Structured multi-step reasoning for complex plans.
sequential-thinking.longDescription: Breaks hard problems into explicit thought steps — useful for chief-of-staff planning, architecture, and research synthesis.

git.name: Git (local)
git.description: Inspect status, log, and diffs in local repositories.
git.longDescription: Read-oriented git tools over a local repo root. Point at your monorepo home or a specific project path after enable if needed.
git.setupNotes: Default root is $HOME — narrow args to a repo path for focus.

everything.name: MCP playground
everything.description: Reference server with sample tools for testing the wire.
everything.longDescription: Official “everything” demo server — handy when validating MCP wiring, Desk settings, or teaching how tools appear in Grok.

brave-search.name: Brave Search
brave-search.description: Web search via Brave Search API for grounded research.
brave-search.longDescription: Same pattern as Claude Desktop research connectors: live search results instead of only model knowledge. Requires a free Brave Search API key.
brave-search.setupNotes: Set BRAVE_API_KEY in your environment (or export before launching Desk).

puppeteer.name: Browser (Puppeteer)
puppeteer.description: Headless Chrome for pages that need a real browser.
puppeteer.longDescription: Navigate and extract from JS-heavy sites — closer to computer-use lite without full desktop RPA. Great for docs that fetch alone cannot render.

google-maps.name: Google Maps
google-maps.description: Places, directions, and geo context for local research.
google-maps.longDescription: Useful for field ops, event planning, and location-aware marketing briefs. Needs a Google Maps API key.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Issues, PRs, and repos via the official GitHub MCP server.
github.longDescription: Core developer connector in Claude Code / Desktop workflows: search code, open issues, review PRs without leaving the agent.

gitlab.name: GitLab
gitlab.description: Projects, MRs, and issues on GitLab.com or self-hosted.
gitlab.longDescription: Parallel to GitHub for teams on GitLab. Point GITLAB_API_URL at self-hosted instances when needed.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.description: Pull error and performance issues from Sentry projects.
sentry.longDescription: Ops-friendly: investigate production errors with Grok using live Sentry context (when configured).
sentry.setupNotes: Set SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN and SENTRY_ORG as required by the server.

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Read channels and draft messages with Slack MCP tools.
slack.longDescription: Cowork staple: status updates, channel summaries, and drafts without alt-tabbing. Requires a Slack bot token with appropriate scopes.
slack.setupNotes: Set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (and team ID if your server requires it).

gdrive.name: Google Drive
gdrive.description: Search and read Drive files the agent is allowed to see.
gdrive.longDescription: Document cowork flow used in Claude connectors: briefs, decks, and shared docs without manual download.
gdrive.setupNotes: Requires Google OAuth credentials per server docs (GDRIVE_* env vars).

postgres.name: PostgreSQL
postgres.description: Query a Postgres database with read-focused MCP tools.
postgres.longDescription: For product ops and analytics agents: schema-aware SQL over a connection string you control.
postgres.setupNotes: Pass a connection URL as the server argument or via DATABASE_URL.

sqlite.name: SQLite
sqlite.description: Query a local SQLite file for offline analysis.
sqlite.longDescription: Zero-ops local analytics: point at a .sqlite file under your home or project tree.
sqlite.setupNotes: Default points at ${HOME}/data.sqlite — change after enable.

aws-kb.name: AWS Knowledge Base
aws-kb.description: Retrieve from an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base.
aws-kb.longDescription: Enterprise knowledge retrieval pattern: grounded answers from indexed internal docs via AWS.
aws-kb.setupNotes: Requires AWS credentials and Bedrock KB configuration.
